model.name: paneTerminal.mount
model.description: Client-render counterpart of paneTerminal.attach (server PtyBridge.attachPane). RbTerminalDetail.mount renders the xterm.js terminal for the selected pane INSIDE the shared rb-detail-drawer detail flow (R31.4 DRY: same scroll / grab-bar / expand / minimize as /trace, showElement retired) and opens the ws to the owner-gated PtyBridge. SINGULAR-CHAIN decision (req-eng, #27/#38 one-class-one-method-per-UC): distinct from paneTerminal.attach fa1845d3, which is singular-bound to PtyBridge.attachPane 6fc43b8e (server) — so R31.4 has TWO UCs (server attach + client mount/render), like R31.3's data+render split. Expert set Class.ownerIor placeholder -> fa1845d3; req-eng re-pointed Class.ownerIor -> this UC and added the forward UC.class/UC.method binding.
